findings.issue: Positive syntax facets discharged by value mutants only
findings.resolution: Unclaimed; the rules are covered through negative/control diagnostic pairs, and runtime facets keep feature mutants.

findings.issue: Negatives violated more than one rule or were diagnosed for another reason
findings.resolution: Each negative now violates only its rule; expectations line-anchored.
Each negative has its own conforming control.

lesson: A syntax rule is tested by what the processor must reject. Each negative must break exactly one rule, next to a control that differs in nothing else.
